BINONDO FIRE NOW ON TASK FORCE CHARLIE
Firefighters battle a massive blaze engulfing hundreds of homes in Parola Compound, Gate 46, Delpan, Binondo, Manila on May 23, 2026, as the fire escalated to Task Force Charlie as of 5:19 p.m., triggering an intensified emergency response.

The fire, which broke out past 3 p.m., rapidly spread across densely packed houses, sending thick smoke into the air as residents scrambled to evacuate while crews raced to prevent further destruction.  via Diann Calucin
